tasks.title: Resolve CLI routing-rule Agent references and encode PATCH omission
tasks.description: Reuse AgentCommands.ResolveAgentAsync after project resolution for routing-rule create and supplied edit --agent values. Build edit JSON only from options present in ParseResult so omitted nullable options are absent, and send the resolved stable agentId before POST/PATCH.
acceptanceCriteria: Create by Agent name and create by Agent id both resolve before POST and send the same stable agentId; the raw name is never sent as agentId.
Edit by Agent name and edit by Agent id both resolve before PATCH and send the same stable agentId.
An edit that supplies only --name, --match, --response-prompt, or --continue sends exactly those canonical JSON properties; omitted properties are absent, not JSON null.
An edit without --agent performs no Agent lookup solely for that omitted option and sends no agentId property.
Unknown create/edit references return non-zero, include the exact original input, and send no routing mutation request.

tasks.title: Correct the minimal Server routing-rule PATCH presence contract
tasks.description: Align RoutingRuleUpdateRequest.Raw, Fields, and RoutingRuleStore.UpdateAsync on the exact JSON vocabulary name, match, agentId, responsePrompt, and continue. Apply present fields and preserve absent fields without adding backend Agent lookup or routing DSL behavior. Keep store application in RoutingRuleStoreSpecs; because no current class owns RoutingRuleUpdateRequest.BindAsync, implementation MAY add the narrowly named Server SpecTests class RoutingRulePatchRoutesSpecs for API binder/presence coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: Server presence tokens are exactly the lower camel-case JSON names `name`, `match`, `agentId`, `responsePrompt`, and `continue`; C# member casing is not used as a presence token.
PATCH values for name, match, agentId, responsePrompt, and continue are each applied when present, while absent values remain unchanged.
A present JSON null is recorded as present and handled by existing validation/normalization rather than silently treated as omission.

No backend Agent name lookup, routing fallback, routing DSL, endpoint expansion, schema expansion, or unrelated Server behavior is introduced.
